auth.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.heroDescription: A lightweight, self-hosted image silo. Keep uploads, processing, management, and direct delivery inside infrastructure you control.

setup.title: Set up ImageSilo
setup.description: Create the administrator account and save the initial image policy. No configuration-file or database editing is required.
setup.bootstrapToken: Bootstrap token from the startup logs
setup.compressionHelp: Try same-format compression and keep the original bytes whenever the result is not smaller.
setup.conversionHelp: Convert JPEG/PNG uploads to WebP. It stays off by default to preserve original bytes and a lightweight runtime.
setup.failed: Setup failed. Check the fields or confirm that this instance has not already been initialized.

nav.searchDescription: Find an image by filename, path, UUID, or SHA-256.
nav.searchHint: Press Command / Ctrl + K from any page

upload.title: Upload images
upload.description: Drop, choose, or paste JPEG, PNG, WebP, and animated GIF files.
upload.dropOrPaste: Drop images here or paste an image from the clipboard
upload.dropHelp: You can also use the file picker below. Unsupported formats are not added.
upload.runtime: Up to {{concurrency}} files are processed at once; each batch can contain {{count}} files.
upload.tooMany: Choose no more than {{count}} files in one batch.
upload.unsupported: Some files were not supported JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF images and were ignored.

images.title: Image management
images.description: Search, filter, and manage paginated images. Lists always load thumbnails only.
images.empty: No images match the current filters.
images.confirmBatchDelete: Permanently delete the selected {{count}} images? This cannot be undone.
images.confirmDelete: Permanently delete “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.

batchStatus.cleanup_pending: Database and index deleted; files await inspection cleanup

images.copyLinksHelp: The main button copies the current format; use the menu to switch between direct, Markdown, BBCode, and HTML.
images.confirmConvertWebp: Convert “{{name}}” to WebP and replace its current stored file? The image ID, direct URL, and aliases stay unchanged, but the original stored file is deleted.
images.noAliases: This image has no historical path aliases.

migrations.title: Migration management
migrations.description: Browse every valid image in the migration tree as a flat library and keep using its original public path.
migrations.empty: No migration images match the current filters.
migrations.refreshFailed: Unable to scan migration files. Check the directory mount and read permissions.
migrations.readOnlyHelp: You can browse, filter, open, and copy links. Delete actions appear only when migration deletion is explicitly enabled.
migrations.writableHelp: Deletion immediately removes the migration file and recursively removes truly empty parent directories. The migration root is never removed.
migrations.skippedFiles: Skipped {{count}} non-image, mismatched, unreadable, or non-public files.
migrations.confirmDelete: Permanently delete “{{path}}”? Empty parent directories will also be removed. This cannot be undone.
migrations.confirmBatchDelete: Permanently delete the selected {{count}} migration images? Empty parent directories will also be removed. This cannot be undone.
migrations.batchPartial: Deleted {{success}} images; {{failed}} deletions or directory cleanups did not fully succeed.
migrations.deleteFailed: Unable to delete migration images. Check the mutation setting, mount mode, and directory permissions.
migrations.selectionLimit: Each batch can contain at most 100 migration images.

aliases.title: Historical path aliases
aliases.description: Upload an image and bind its old URL. Old paths return image bytes directly without redirects.
aliases.imageHelp: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF. Saving uploads it and binds the historical path in one action.
aliases.createFailed: Unable to create the mapping. Check the image, historical path, or path conflict.
aliases.notFound: No alias was found for this path.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.description: Create scoped Bearer tokens. Plaintext is shown once and never stored by ImageSilo.
apiTokens.name: Token name
apiTokens.createFailed: Unable to create the API token.
apiTokens.copyNow: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
apiTokens.confirmRevoke: Revoke API token “{{name}}”? This takes effect immediately.

scopeHelp.images:delete: Permanently delete single or batched images.
scopeHelp.aliases:write: Create or import historical URL aliases.

settings.overviewHelp: Shows current image, storage, memory, index, and maintenance state without collecting traffic trends.
